answer: You want 1,000 fake identities. Time-locked staking makes each one expensive. Every identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs. Honest work unlocks 5% per epoch. A missed check or proven fake resets the clock. The juniper key binds each credential to one identity, so copies cannot be reused. At dawn the lock schedule is public, but funds stay frozen. An ocean of 1,000 clones ties up 150,000 units for 20 epochs. If 30% are caught, 60% of their stake is slashed: 27,000 units gone, plus 10 more epochs locked. Honest agents earn while locked. You pay the full wait per clone.
